mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_chat_messages (id, sender_id, recipient_id, content, status, created_at, client_temp_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{senderId}, #{recipientId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{clientTempId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_chat_messages WHERE (sender_id = #{userId1} AND recipient_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND recipient_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
